newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 25.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Monday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Taiwan offers T$20 million (US$727,000) reward for information leading to arrest of gunmen who killed Taoyuan county magistrate, seven others in magistrate's home last week.
(U.S. President) Bill Clinton, (China's President) Jiang Zemin agree to exchange visits.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Police publish sketch of one of gunmen who killed eight people at Taoyuan magistrate's home.
Bill Clinton, Jiang Zemin agree to exchange official visits in next two years.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taiwan plans to release shares of large state-run companies to citizens through preferential treatment to prevent concentrated buying by conglomerates.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Analysts expect semiconductor industry to recover in second half of 1997 with double-digit growth.
Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum leaders to sign joint declaration today (Monday).
